semiconductor_relevance: High — JCU provides specialized chemicals and equipment for critical back-end processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JCU is a key player in the semiconductor industry, offering surface treatment chemicals and equipment that enhance high-density wiring connections in semiconductor chips. Their solutions include copper plating chemicals for redistribution layers and technologies supporting TSVs, TGVs, and megapillars, addressing complex challenges in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Copper plating chemicals for redistribution layers
Surface treatment solutions for next-generation semiconductors
Technologies supporting through-silicon vias (TSVs) and through-glass vias (TGVs)
